title: XRCraft
description: XRCraftMC is a Minecraft server focusing on VR compatibility with support for all.
body:
# XRCraft Network
**Note: It is recommended to get Vivecraft and Simple Voicechat.**

XRCraft is a cross-version Minecraft server sporting many different gamemodes and an allowance on VR players along with Simple Voice Chat support.

### Why?
XRCraft exists to bridge the gap for players who would like a Minecraft server with a community, and VR support.
We invite all to join the server, free of any entrance fee or any type of microtransactions, required purchases and or lootboxes.

For our Survival gamemode, we try our best to have a no reset, safe community, where you are able to jump in without issue, updating to the latest version of the game as soon as it is possible for us.

We hope to finally unify the fractured VR community, and bring it together, allowing PC players to also have fun.

## Available gamemodes
Survival - An ever growing SMP

FFA - A KitPVP gamemode

Parkour - Infinite Parkour

Bedwars - The classic bedwars gamemode

Minigames - Many small minigames for fun

## Coming Soon
Economy - SMP-like server with a world map, economy, claims and trading.

## Extra Information
XRCraft is hosted on server-class hardware in Canada

Please try to be PG 13.
